c002.section: Universal Usage Standards › Do Not Compromise Critical Infrastructure

c008.summary: No child exploitation, grooming, or abuse.

c009.text: any individual under the age of 18 years old, regardless of jurisdiction.

c012.section: Universal Usage Standards › Do Not Create or Spread Disinformation
c012.summary: Disclosed fiction, satire, and parody are exceptions.

c016.summary: Consented tracking and anonymized analysis can qualify for exceptions.

c018.section: Universal Usage Standards › Do Not Abuse Our Platform
c018.summary: No guardrail evasion or unauthorized access.
